up a righteous Kingdom for he remembered what the Lord had done in bringing Jared & his Brother across the deep & he did walk in the ways of the Lord& he begat Sons & daughters & his eldest Son whose name was Shez did rebell against him nevertheless Shez was smitten by the hand of a robber becauseof his exceding riches which brought Peace again unto his father & it came to pass that his father did build up many cities upon the face of the land& the People began again to spread over all the face of the land & Shez did live to an exceding old age & he begat Riplakish & he died & Riplakish reignedin his stead & it came to pass that Riplakish did not do that which was right in the sight of the Lord for he did have many wives & concubines & did lay thatupon mens shoulders which was grievious to be born yea he did tax them with heavy taxes & with the taxes he did build many spacious buildings & he diderect him an exceding beautiful throan & he did build many prisons & who so would not be subject unto taxes he did cast into prison & whoso were not ableto pay taxes he did cast into prison & he did cause that they should labour continually for their support & whoso refused to labour he did cause to be put todeath wherefore he did obtain all his fine work yea even his fine gold he did cause to be refined in prison & all manner of fine workmanship he did cause
